thread.title: Spotify Stock Initiated At Neutral, Limited Upside Seen

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Spotify Stock Initiated At Neutral, Limited Upside Seen
text:
A Wall Street analyst on Tuesday initiated coverage of Spotify Technology ( SPOT ) with the equivalent of a neutral rating, saying the streaming music leader has limited upside.
X Oppenheimer analyst Jason Helfstein started Spotify at a perform rating and estimated that the stock has a value range of 160 to 170. Spotify stock rose 1.7% to 180.43 on the stock market today .
Spotify went public on April 3, ending its first day at 149.01. It hit an all-time high of 182.45 on June 22.
Spotify will have a hard time differentiating itself from rivals such as Apple ( AAPL ) Music because it offers the same catalog of songs, Helfstein said. It also has limited leverage with the music labels to negotiate for better terms that could improve its profitability, he said.

Please contact customer service CLOSE The big three music labels are Vivendi's ( VIVHY ) Universal Music Group, the Sony Music Entertainment division of Japanese conglomerate Sony ( SNE ), and Warner Music Group, a division of privately held Access Industries. They, along with Merlin, a representative of many independent labels, control access to most music today with a catalog of 35 million tracks.
Competition From Large Players Spotify is the leader in subscription-streaming music services today, but the relationship between scale and success is not as well defined in the sector as it is in other internet businesses, he said.
Scale has translated to market dominance for firms such as Amazon.com ( AMZN ), Netflix ( NFLX ) and Airbnb, he said.
"Their leadership is a positive feedback loop as content/product availability increases proportionally to consumer demand," Helfstein said. "We see no such force in music streaming because supply has no relationship to demand."
The music streaming market ultimately will be shared by a few scaled players, he said. Some like Amazon, Apple and Alphabet 's ( GOOGL ) Google have other businesses that can create cross-selling opportunities using music services.
Spotify ended the March quarter with 75 million paying subscribers. It also had 99 million monthly active users of its free, ad-supported service in the first quarter.
Oppenheimer predicts that Spotify can reach 218 million paying subscribers by 2024. It sees Spotify growing to 250 million ad-supported users in the same period.
